definitions.gloss: to collide; to crash into; to run into
definitions.explanation: Physical collision between objects, vehicles, or people.

definitions.gloss: to clash; to conflict; to come into opposition
definitions.explanation: Figurative conflict between opinions, interests, or groups.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}が{壁|かべ}に{衝突|しょうとつ}した。
examples.english: The car crashed into the wall.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}で{二台|にだい}の{車|くるま}が{衝突|しょうとつ}する{事故|じこ}があった。
examples.english: There was an accident where two cars collided at the intersection.

examples.japanese: {小惑星|しょうわくせい}が{地球|ちきゅう}に{衝突|しょうとつ}する{可能性|かのうせい}は{極|きわ}めて{低|ひく}い。
examples.english: The possibility of an asteroid colliding with Earth is extremely low.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}が{衝突|しょうとつ}した。
{二|ふた}つの{国|くに}の{利害|りがい}が{衝突|しょうとつ}している。
examples.english: The interests of the two countries are in conflict.

examples.japanese: {世代間|せだいかん}の{価値観|かちかん}が{衝突|しょうとつ}することは{珍|めずら}しくない。
examples.english: It's not unusual for generational values to clash.

notes:
Can be used both as an intransitive verb (AとBが{衝突|しょうとつ}する) and with に to mark the object hit (Aに{衝突|しょうとつ}する). The noun form {衝突|しょうとつ} is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正面|しょうめん}{衝突|しょうとつ}: head-on collision
- {衝突|しょうとつ}{事故|じこ}: collision accident
- {意見|いけん}が{衝突|しょうとつ}する: opinions clash
- {利害|りがい}が{衝突|しょうとつ}する: interests conflict
- {衝突|しょうとつ}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid a collision/conflict

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぶつかる: to bump into; to hit — everyday spoken word for physical collisions
- {対立|たいりつ}する: to oppose; to be in opposition — emphasizes ongoing tension rather than a single clash
- {激突|げきとつ}する: to crash violently — more dramatic; implies greater force
